text: どうにか　ちょうしが　でてきたな！

structure.jp: ちょうしが　でてきたな！
structure.en: you've started to get into the swing of it!

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb says something has started to appear or has been building up until now. ちょうしが でてきた = 'the swing of it has started to show'.

patterns.name: 〜な (remark)
patterns.explanation: な at the end is a relaxed, mostly male way to share a thought, like 'huh' or 'eh'. でてきたな = 'it's started to show, eh'.
